author: Chicago City Wire
title: Chicago Fire FC draws with Atlanta United FC
text:
Dave Baldwin President of Business Operations | Chicago Fire FC Website
Dave Baldwin President of Business Operations | Chicago Fire FC Website
Chicago Fire FC and Atlanta United FC ended their match in a 2-2 draw at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. Philip Zinckernagel scored his 10th goal of the season for Chicago, giving them an early lead. Zinckernagel also assisted Maren Haile-Selassie's second goal of the campaign.
Atlanta equalized in the second half with a goal from Alexey Miranchuk, set up by Miguel Almirón. Haile-Selassie restored Chicago's lead in the 79th minute, but Atlanta's Will Reilly scored during stoppage time to level the game again.
The draw marked Chicago Fire FC's first point at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in eight regular-season matches. They last won there during the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup Round of 16 in June 2018.
Next, Chicago will face CF Montréal on July 19 at Stade Saputo. The match will be available globally on MLS Season Pass on Apple TV and locally on wlsam.com and Que Buena Fire via the Uforia App.
Philip Zinckernagel now has nine assists this season, totaling 19 goal contributions for the year, ranking eighth for a single season with Chicago Fire FC. Andrew Gutman recorded his eighth assist during Haile-Selassie's goal, setting a personal record for goal contributions in one season.
Attendance at Mercedes-Benz Stadium was reported as 38,882.
